description_en: Invoke the DeleteEmailVerification API to delete an email address that has passed verification
description_zh: 调用DeleteEmailVerification接口删除已经验证通过的邮箱
kebab_example: aliyun domain delete-email-verification --lang en --email test1@aliyun.com,test2@aliyun.com --user-client-ip 127.0.0.1 --api-version 2018-01-29 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteEmailVerification

parameters.help_en:
Language of the error message returned by the API. Valid values:
zh: Chinese.
en: English.

Default value: en
parameters.help_zh:
接口返回错误信息语言。取值：
zh：中文。
en：英文。

默认值为en
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: Email addresses to be deleted, separated by commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 待删除的邮箱，多个邮箱之间使用英文逗号（,）隔开
parameters.name: email

parameters.help_en: User IP address, which can be set to 127.0.0.1
parameters.name: user_client_ip
